name: Katja
source:
Katya Ulyanova is a fiery student and one of the most outspoken members of the student political circle at Ardensky National University. She is a firm believer in socialism and fights for the ideals of social justice, equality and fraternity. Born into a family of political refugees, she was raised with strong collectivist and internationalist values, which shaped her into an unyielding advocate for change.

Katya is charismatic, fearless, and unafraid to speak her mind. She thrives in ideological debates, rallies, and protests, where her words ignite the spirits of those around her. She views political struggle as the defining purpose of her life and refuses to stand idly by in the face of injustice. While her passion is inspiring, her impulsiveness and unwillingness to compromise can sometimes put her and her allies at risk.
